title: Route from the Varangians to the Greeks

photo.caption: Map showing the major Varangian trade routes: the Volga trade route (in red) and the trade route from the Varangians to the Greeks (in purple). Other trade routes of the 8th to the 11th centuries are shown in orange.
photo.description: Map showing the major Varangian trade routes, the Volga trade route (in red) and the Trade Route from the Varangians to the Greeks (in blue). Other trade routes of the 8th–11th centuries shown in orange. There are two versions of the source map: one corresponds to Hungarian historiography, which believes that speakers of the Eastern Romance languages (the Vlachs) disappeared for a thousand-year period between 275 and 1300; the other corresponds to Romanian historiography, which does not accept this.

photo.caption: A coloured copy of runestone G 280 which talks of death in the Dnieper Rapids.
